What's under the hood
01
Few-shot, not zero-shot. The prompt includes worked examples of real incidents and their correct classification, so Claude anchors to your organization's judgment calls, not generic defaults.
02
Forced structure. The model returns one exact JSON shape every time — category, subcategory, priority, team, actions — so downstream systems never have to guess the format.
03
Clear priority bands. Critical means business-stopping or 50+ users affected; Low means cosmetic with a workaround — the model is decisive, not hedging.
